The name alone on the top line (no "Account · in dollars"), Rename and Remove behind one ⋯ menu instead of two big round buttons. The total with no "total value" and no % beside it; on a page drawn in dollars the same figure in baht under it (Webull: $ 8,782 over ฿ 297,768 on the demo). Under it a small table in the holdings table's look, Amount and %: Unrealised (what is held now) and All time (the +3.3% that sat beside the total), so the green % and the red loss no longer read as two answers to one question. The line follows with no heading; Holdings no longer repeats the total ("N at cost" stays). test/ledger-accttop-e2e.mjs drives the demo: the ⋯ opens Rename / Remove and a press elsewhere shuts it, the baht line is the account in baht, both rows match the holdings in dollars, SET has no baht line; red when the conversion or the baht line is broken. holdprofit + acctpending e2e pass. papa.label: Papa's book
papa.subject: papa news reads Bloomberg, the FT and The Edge Singapore in full, not just their headlines. A page a plain request is refused is asked again through curl_cffi (Python), which makes the TLS handshake a browser's: these sites block on the handshake, not the user-agent. Bloomberg's page carries the whole story in __NEXT_DATA__ (read by bloombergStory); the FT needs Safari's handshake and Google as referrer; The Edge's premium pieces are cut to their opening on its server, kept and labelled as an opening. The three never fall back to the free reader (it handed back Bloomberg's teaser as the article), and reads to them go one at a time, 3 s apart, after Bloomberg blocked the home address following ~8 quick reads. Live, laptop: 12/12 Bloomberg (incl. Google-found Thailand links), 6/6 FT, Edge news whole and premium as opening; Pi, in the papa-news sandbox: 8 Bloomberg and 6/6 FT before Bloomberg's block. Unit 539/539; mutants (quotes dropped, Edge access ignored, reader allowed for the walled three) red. Pi venv /opt/papa-fetch-venv; note papa-news-walled-sites. Asked: "im fine with working around paywalls and bot checks as its a private app. 1. is fine. any methods is fine. i do not want to only read title tbh".

packing.label: Vacation
packing.subject: Vacation: where we ate is Go back or skip (design C of packing/design/restaurants-2-2026-11-21). On an area's page, places of 3 stars and up are GO BACK tiles, two a row, best first: the score big with its star (rainbow when picked), yellow from 4 stars, the name and the best dish. Under 3 stars is a plain SKIP list with each score, and places not rated yet a NOT RATED list. No photos. A tap still opens the place; Edit's Add a place sits under them. autopics.mjs: Kodam Kitchen under GO BACK in yellow with Mango sticky rice, Corner Restaurant under SKIP with 1.5, Jungle Kitchen under NOT RATED, no photo, the star beside its number (red when it was stacked above); drive.mjs and after.mjs read the new sections; all pass, unit tests pass. planner.label: Planner
planner.subject: Planner: the widget's weeks are one layout each, its presses go first, and the app's glide leaves at the finger's speed. Widget: each week was about 25 small layouts (each day's tap target, number and stack) before any event, all inflated by the home screen at every ‹ ›; now a week is one layout with its seven days in it and only the events are added. ‹ ›, Today and a to-do's tick are sent as foreground broadcasts. App: the glide started at 4 to 16 times the finger's speed, so the month jumped ahead at the let-go; now it leaves at the finger's speed and slows into place (a press of ‹ › keeps its quick start), and the shown month is a layer of its own. month-scroll.mjs 35 checks (the start-speed check red with the old curve); page.mjs passes; javacheck compiles, 80 unit tests pass. Asked: "It's a lot better, but it still takes around half a second in the widget, and there's still a tiny lag when swapping."
